form.title: Build the next live trading session
form.description: Choose strategy, market, execution mode, and costs before the engine starts routing signals and market data.
form.live_warning: LIVE MODE: Real money will be used. Confirm your Binance API keys, permissions, and risk limits before launch.
form.paper_hint: High-fidelity paper mode connects to exchange testnet APIs so you can verify market data, balances, logs, and order routing without touching production funds.
form.balance_source_live: Live mode loads the available quote balance directly from the exchange account before the session starts.
form.balance_source_paper: High-fidelity paper mode loads the available quote balance directly from the exchange testnet account before the session starts.
form.sidebar_description: The launcher should answer three questions before anything goes live: what strategy runs, what market it trades, and which exchange account supplies the capital.
form.check_strategy_text: For validation sessions, prefer noisy test strategies that make logs and order flow easy to verify before switching to production code.
form.check_mode_text: Use exchange testnet mode to verify feed status, account sync, order routing, and UI visibility before you arm real execution.
form.check_risk_text: The launcher no longer accepts local fake balances. Missing credentials, balances, or market data should fail fast.
